failures.reason: The second fixture actor was accidentally connected to itself; corrected target from fixed ids[1] to ids[1-index]. Rejection 400 was expected for that invalid self-connect, not an expiration implementation failure.

failures.reason: The fixture gave both people the same published planning answer, so there was no alignment offer and no key. Corrected to explicit differing answers and checked no-public-difference after expiry.

related34.counting: Included in root regression evidence; do not add these same existing cases again.

contracts.rawOwner: profile.values, profile.required and independently stored profile.expirations remain available to the owner. Expired values are not removed from storage.
contracts.projection: view.publicAnswers has current values, unchanged required IDs, expiredFields as field-ID strings. Authorized peers receive current public values, no expiration map or old expired values.
contracts.input: Absent expiration keys preserve their saved deadline. Only explicit null clears it. New deadlines must be canonical future UTC ISO. An unchanged past deadline and unchanged answer may round-trip.
contracts.baselinePublication: Copies explicitly selected valid baseline values only; preserves existing public deadlines and never copies a private deadline.
contracts.newIntroduction: Current send/accept gates reject expired mandatory public evidence and current required sender comparisons. Recipient private answers are never invented or newly required.
contracts.acceptedIntroduction: Public deadline expiry does not retroactively close accepted introductions or confirmed appointments; schedule hints and alignment read current public fields.
contracts.preview: Owner and peer current public projection binds previews, so a clock-only expiry invalidates an issued preview even if revisions are unchanged.

limitations: Local synthetic proof does not establish satisfaction or production operation.

A region comparison may retain the adapter legacy/inactive label if all compared areas have expired; the current service prevents introduction and the owner expiry projection reports the expired answer. No adapter expansion was made.
